name: Men's Two-Piece Quartz Watch and Bracelet Set
description: A two-piece set: a quartz watch on a brown or tan PU strap and a matching bracelet. The three small sub-dials on the numeral dials are decorative. The gift box and props in the photos are not included.

specs.label: Case and dial
specs.value: Black case, black dial with orange-tone markings

specs.label: Bracelet
specs.value: Brown cord with a metal "believe" plate, or woven black and tan

source.notes: Supplier: Yiwu Lisong Trading Co., Ltd. (same shop as the other two watch sets), 1K+ sold. Title as shown: 'Temu2-Piece Men's Watch Set, Sporty, Casual, Fashionable, Digital Round Dial, Quartz, and Pu Woven Strap Wristwatch'; 'Temu' (another retailer's name), 'Sporty' and 'Digital' (the dials are analogue) left out. Price tiers CNY 7.5 (about N1,675) from 1 item, CNY 7 (about N1,563.33) for 360-1199, CNY 6.5 (about N1,451.66) for 1200+; fx_rate 223.33 = 1675 / 7.5. Owner chose unit_cost 7.5 and price 7500 on 2 Nov 2026. Listing shows 'Standard Consolidation - Air to Nigeria'; no freight figure given. Weight 50 g per set in all four colours (Brown, Brown 1, Brown 2, Khaki), supplier-stated. Supplier attributes: brand 'Box pine2', model 8-110/111, print logo: can, imported: No; unused. Sizes from the supplier's parameters photo (hand-measured, minor errors): dial 42 mm, thickness 9 mm, band 20 mm wide and 235 mm long, watch 28 g. The supplier's own photo labels the three sub-dials 'Nonfunctional decoration': not called a chronograph. Whether the date window works is not stated. 3 styles photographed; the listing has 4 colours and the mapping to photos is not shown, so the fourth is not listed. Photos say 'Boxes not included' / 'Photo Props': box, cushion and props not included; captions cropped out. Dials print 'Geneva' / 'GENEVA' on every style: owner chose to list under a generic name; not retouched, kept out of name, copy and tags. The dial close-up carrying the supplier's label is not used. Store return rate not shown. Bracelet length and materials not stated (only 'PU' in the title); none claimed. Watch has a button cell (type unknown); ships_by_air unset like the other watches.

history.note: draft only, not on sale. Geneva dials listed under a generic name (owner's choice).
